interpretation_guardrail: PASS rejects only the hypothesis that the official DR11 resolved brick-level footprint/primary-coverage summary explains the locality signal. It does not establish a cosmological origin and does not replace a point-level official-random selection-function test.

official_brick_inputs.coverage_rule: PHOTSYS=S and DRVERSION=11 -> FALLPRIMGE1DR11; PHOTSYS=S and DRVERSION=9 -> FALLPRIMGE1DR9S; otherwise 0

primary_hypothesis.C: official resolved brick-level footprint/coverage explains the observed local continuity
primary_hypothesis.D: PASS iff median adjusted advantage >= 0.10 and one-sided sign/Wilcoxon p<0.01; FAIL if median<=0 or either p>=0.05; otherwise UNCERTAIN
primary_hypothesis.H: official brick-coverage-adjusted ring-hidden locality remains above matched shift
primary_hypothesis.T: 48 provenance-fixed REAL_DR11 fields; n_min=36; one primary paired field statistic
primary_hypothesis.U: sub-brick masks/depth/PSF, deblending, Galactic foregrounds, tracer population, brick-summary approximation

science_scope: official-random resolved brick footprint plus survey-brick primary coverage; not point-level randoms
